text:
deploy-bot: Deployment started: release v2.14.0 -> US canary (canary-17)
olivia: kicked off. @jun can you confirm capacity in us-west1?
jun: Checking... running `ramp-check --region us-west1 --since 10m`
infra-bot: autoscaler: added 4 workers to us-west1-gpu-pool-3
matt: saw a 5% latency blip on p95 for gen endpoints, non-urgent
sarah: what's our rollback threshold? current runbook says p95 > 800ms or error-rate > 1.5%
olivia: correct. also threshold for token-cost anomaly is +30%
jun: capacity looks fine, headroom 18% before we hit reserved commit
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5000 reqs, health checks PASSED
olivia: ok proceed to EU canary at 15:05 UTC. I'll hand off to @eoin for EU
eoin: on it. pinning model to v2.14.0 in EU to avoid auto-swap
infra-bot: pinned model-version=v2.14.0 on eu-central-1
deploy-bot: Starting EU canary
matt: EU p95 baseline 220ms, watch for spikes
jun: running stress probe: `loadgen --region eu-central-1 --rps 2000 --dur 10m`
infra-bot: Notice: APAC pool low on burst quota today (remaining 1.2h)
sarah: APAC needs backfill plan. If EU shows issues we hold APAC. Can we pre-warm another pool?
jun: proposing backfill: shift 2 GPUs from dev-preemptible -> apac-burst for 45m
olivia: approve the backfill, but only if cost estimate < $120/hr. Jun, share estimate.
jun: estimate ~95$/hr
deploy-bot: EU canary metrics steady. error-rate 0.3%, p95 245ms
olivia: proceed APAC canary at 16:00 JST but ensure holdpoint after 10m for manual sign-off
eoin: I'll do the sign-off. Runbook: if error-rate > 1% OR p95 > 700ms -> rollback
matt: small anomaly at EU 16:06, spike to 820ms for 30s, no sustained errors
sarah: monitor for 5m window before proceed
infra-bot: APAC prewarm complete, added 2 GPUs to apac-burst
deploy-bot: APAC canary started
olivia: logging release notes: v2.14.0 - kernel perf improvements, batching changes, routing fallback
jun: adding note: APAC burst borrowed from dev pool; will return 16:45 JST
eoin: sign-off at 16:15 JST - APAC can proceed to regional rollout
deploy-bot: Rolling out to US/EU/APAC regions sequentially with 10% ramp steps
matt: watch for KV cache hit-rate regressions
sarah: creating incident if rollout needs full rollback. Run rollback: `deploy rollback --release v2.14.0 --regions all`
olivia: after full regional rollouts, schedule post-rollout smoke for 1h
jun: will trigger capacity sweep script at +30m
deploy-bot: Rollout complete in US/EU/APAC, final status: success
olivia: great work team. I'll update release note doc and tag infra/sre
matt: let's retro tomorrow re: the transient EU spike
eoin: noted
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled down apac-burst, returned 2 GPUs to dev-preemptible
sarah: closing thread, keep an eye on costs this week :eyes:
